name: 1ClickWebsite API
description: Create complete V2 websites, generate Lead Gen mini-sites, manage white-label agency requests, and edit completed WordPress sites. Platform endpoints use a 1ClickWebsite bearer API key. Site Editing endpoints run against the generated site and use a WordPress username and application password.
